summary.authority: One active hide per account and Today candidate; one acknowledgment per reminder occurrence
summary.delete_merge: A hide ends when shown, reverted, expired, or its source closes; an acknowledgment ends when its reminder moves

rows.commands: n/a:projections take no commands; only the projector writes (spec 1993-1996)

projection.watermark: source change-set watermark, projector name and version, build time, per-source health, partial or stale flags, and rebuild identity (spec 1982-1991)
projection.stale: A read that needs a commit position waits for or bypasses the projection until its watermark reaches it (spec 1993-1997).
projection.degraded: A failed source marks the projection degraded with per-source health; it never reads as an empty result (spec 1998).
